candidate_observations.address: Holland & Barrett, 253 High Street, Bangor, Clwyd, LL57 1PB
observed_facts: The 6 May 2026 lot was Withdrawn Post, but the same property was reoffered on 16 July 2026 as ACUITUS-5812 and remains Available at a guide of £175,000+.
Holland & Barrett Retail Limited, company 02758955, is active and pays £18,000 under a five-year lease from 24 February 2026.
The lease contains a tenant option to determine on the third anniversary of the term, before the nominal 23 February 2031 expiry.
The virtual freehold comprises two 999-year leases at peppercorn rent; the later particulars also record a three-month rent-free period with seller top-up but do not expose a complete start date.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The original May withdrawal was not treated as current status. Income was not presented as secure to 2031, the missing rent-free date was not invented and peppercorn rent was not counted as income.
